security_audit.summary: The skill is a design guide, but it directs users and agents to install and run external CLI commands. Most static hits are markdown false positives; confirmed risks relate to npx installs, belt remote inference calls, and possible upload of app assets.

remediation.suggestion: Use pinned, reviewed installation instructions and require explicit user confirmation before running npx or skill installation commands.

remediation.issue: Remote inference commands process user content
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear data handling warning before belt app run examples, especially when prompts or local screenshots may contain private app assets.
Pin external installation links to a reviewed commit or include trusted installation steps directly in the skill documentation.

content.value_statement: App store listings need exact image sizes, clear ordering, and captions that sell the value. This skill helps plan Apple App Store and Google Play screenshots, mockups, localization, and preview videos.
actual_capabilities: Lists required screenshot dimensions for key iPhone, iPad, and Google Play formats.
Explains how to order screenshot galleries around the first three visible images.
Provides caption rules and examples focused on user benefits.
Gives prompt patterns for device mockups, feature callouts, lifestyle scenes, and preview video scenes.
Covers localization priorities, Google Play experiments, and common store listing mistakes.
limitations: Does not verify current App Store Connect or Google Play Console policy changes automatically.
Requires a separate belt CLI setup for the included remote generation examples.
Does not inspect real app screens or generate final assets unless connected tools are run.
Generated examples may need brand, legal, and platform review before submission.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Mobile App
use_cases.description: Plan the first screenshot set with correct dimensions, clear gallery order, and benefit-focused captions.

use_cases.title: Refresh Store Listing Creative
use_cases.description: Turn updated app features into new mockup prompts, captions, and preview video scenes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Localized Assets
use_cases.description: Prioritize markets and decide when to recreate screenshots or translate only the captions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My Screenshot Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one app listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an app store screenshot plan for my app. The app is [describe app], the main users are [audience], and the top three benefits are [benefits]. Include the first three screenshots, captions, and required sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Write Benefit Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these screenshot captions so they are benefit-focused, readable, and under two lines: [paste captions]. Keep the tone [tone] and suggest a stronger first screenshot caption.

prompt_templates.title: Create Mockup Prompts
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate art direction for store assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Write device mockup prompts for [app category]. I need a hero screenshot, a feature callout, and a lifestyle context image. Use [brand colors], [device type], and [visual style].

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Full Store Gallery
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this planned screenshot gallery for App Store and Google Play readiness: [paste gallery order, captions, sizes, and target markets]. Identify weak positions, sizing risks, localization gaps, and A/B test ideas.

output_examples.input: A habit tracking app needs its first App Store screenshots planned.
output: Screenshot 1: Hero habit dashboard with caption focused on staying consistent.
Screenshot 2: Streak and reminder feature with a clear value comparison.
Screenshot 3: Weekly progress view that shows the user outcome.

output_examples.input: A team wants better captions for a finance app listing.
output: Changed feature-first captions into user benefit statements.
Reduced copy to two short lines per screenshot.
Moved the strongest savings outcome into the first screenshot.

output_examples.input: A product marketer needs a preview video outline.
output: Open with the core result in the first three seconds.
Show two key interactions with clean transitions.
End with the app icon and a concise call to action.

best_practices: Design the first three screenshots to explain the app value without scrolling.
Use exact platform dimensions before exporting final assets.
Keep captions short, benefit-focused, and readable at store thumbnail sizes.
anti_patterns: Do not lead with settings, onboarding, or empty states unless they are the product value.
Do not reuse the same composition across every screenshot.
Do not submit generated screenshots without checking brand, privacy, and platform requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill create final screenshot files?
faq.answer: It provides planning guidance and example prompts. Final generation requires connected tools such as the belt CLI examples.

faq.question: Which stores does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Apple App Store and Google Play screenshot guidance, including common dimensions and preview video notes.

faq.question: Can it help with app store optimization?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on screenshot order, captions, feature selection, and A/B testing ideas for store listings.

faq.question: Does it support localization planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests priority markets and when to translate captions or create new localized screenshots.

faq.question: Are the platform specs always current?
faq.answer: No. Review current Apple and Google documentation before submitting final assets.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare your app category, main audience, top benefits, brand style, target platforms, and current app screens.
